CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   D. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.

9. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

11. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)

13. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)

14. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)

15. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain A hand writes on the wall and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Mount Carmel Contest and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
